## Discrepancies

### DISC-1: LLMService second-layer default `?? 2048` not mentioned in FSD [Low]

- **FSD says:** Default context window / `maxTokens` budget is **800** tokens (FSD data-model & budget sections; OI-06 default kept at 800).
- **Actual codebase:** `backend/src/modules/memory/llm/LLMService.ts:46` —
  `maxTokens: config?.maxTokens ?? defaults.maxTokens ?? 2048` — a second-layer fallback of
  **2048** exists when both `config.maxTokens` and `defaults.maxTokens` are undefined.
  (`backend/src/modules/memory/llm/analyzer.ts:72` has the same `?? 2048`.)
- **Impact:** Low. In practice the first layer (config/defaults = 800) always applies, so the
  2048 branch is unreachable under normal configuration; documented in TDD §11 (OI-06) as a
  second-layer default, not a contradiction of the 800 requirement.
- **Recommended fix:** BA adds one sentence to FSD (OI-06 section): "Second-layer code default
  when no config/defaults present = 2048 (defensive, unreachable in normal operation);
  primary default remains 800."

### DISC-3: FSD script paths omit `backend/` prefix [Low]

- **FSD says:** Re-enrich scripts are at `scripts/reenrich-pega*.ts`
  (FSD lines 74, 121, 619, 894, 1219, 1232, 1294 — 7 occurrences).
- **Actual codebase:** Scripts live at **`backend/scripts/`**:
  - `backend/scripts/reenrich-pega.ts`
  - `backend/scripts/reenrich-pega-declarative.ts`
  - `backend/scripts/reenrich-pega-all.ts`
- **Impact:** Low — operational/traceability only. A reader running `scripts/reenrich-pega*.ts`
  from repo root would not find the files. BRD has the same issue (lines 82, 294, 419, 445).
  TDD consistently uses the full `backend/scripts/` path (see TDD §9, §10 Phase 6, §12).
- **Recommended fix:** BA updates FSD (and optionally BRD) script references to
  `backend/scripts/reenrich-pega*.ts`.
